title: Acquire one exact quartic value certificate without a coordinate-shape conversion
statement: For the unchanged seeded rational perturbed four-variable Choi-Lam input, the acquired execution builds a fresh degree40value polynomial directly in grevlex, without prior FGLM/shape/value data. Its hardened exact checker uses569admissible primes and13232product bits above the13227bit height bound, isolates28real values and gives original-objective gap1.1900111654e-5<1e-4. This is the named executed input, not a generic fast optimizer.
